breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified and fixed the physical inaccuracy. The incomplete prompt stated that pressure increases toward the center of curvature, which is incorrect. The generated specification correctly states, 'Pressure gradient is directed outward from the center of curvature,' which aligns with the ground truth's implication that pressure is higher on the outside of the turn.
